:::{#exm-random-choice-auto}
#### Choosing a car at random from the Auto data

The Auto data of @exm-random-experiment have
`{r} nrow(read.csv("data/auto.csv"))` car models.
Let $S$ be the set of car models in the data.
Choosing a car at random from $S$ (@def-random-choice),
with the counting measure, gives each car
probability $1/\abs{S}$,
so the probability that the car has four cylinders
is the fraction of cars with four cylinders:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
# read the local copy of the Auto data (one row per car model):
auto <- read.csv("data/auto.csv")

# the event "four cylinders" is the set of rows where cylinders == 4;
# the mean of the logical vector is |A| / |S|, the probability in
# the definition of choosing at random:
mean(auto$cylinders == 4)
```
:::
